506559.name: Trenčianska Teplá
506559.note: The website's election pages (2022–2026) hold only OVK minutes and results, no okrsky announcement for this vote; the referendum 2026 page links a file on trencin.sk (another municipality's website), not usable. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509515.name: Vysoká nad Kysucou
509515.note: The only okrsky document found for these votes (referendum 2023, archived) names each okrsok only by its area and polling station (1 Ústredie, 2 Nižný Kelčov, 3 Vyšný Kelčov), without the parts or houses it covers; the municipality has 8 parts and the part Vysoká nad Kysucou is split between okrsky 1 and 2, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. The website and the Internet Archive hold no other okrsky document for 2017–2026 (the 2026 area descriptions are for the October 2026 elections).

526657.name: Žehra
526657.note: The notice of this vote describes the two okrsky only by area names ("Žehra centrálna časť, Žehra časť Hodkovce" and "Sídlisko Dreveník, Osada Dreveník") without house numbers; all addresses are numbered by súpisné číslo without streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it.
